name: Meteoric-Reliquary

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: They dwell in pressure-keeps beneath the ice, mining heat from the mantle seams.

description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are massive canyon systems, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Settlement lights trace the coastlines and river-veins, visible from high orbit.
the pirate hideout was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
